item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 13, 2026
item.description: Making a fresh start might require some thought now. With structured Saturn entering impulsive Aries at 7:11 pm EST, it’ll be necessary to carefully define the goals and projects that we want to pursue. As the emotional Moon stimulates expansive Jupiter, we’ll probably be drawn to a variety of possibilities. item.title: Federal funds set to flow again for Hudson River Tunnel project, at least for now
item.description: The Trump administration initially froze funding last fall, announcing that they would block the distribution of the congressionally approved funds just hours into last year's federal government shutdown.

item.title: FBI shares new suspect description, doubles reward in Nancy Guthrie case
item.description: The FBI has released new details regarding the suspect in the abduction of Nancy Guthrie, while doubling its reward for information.

item.title: Former NYPD School Safety commander indicted in bribery scheme
item.description: The former head of the NYPD School Safety division tried to steer city contracts to a Florida businessman in exchange for cash payments, luxury hotel stays and Broadway tickets, federal officials said.

item.title: NYPD releases mugshot, identifies suspect wanted for 2024 fatal shooting of Bronx teen
item.description: Christopher Mejia, 28, is being sought in connection with the fatal shooting of Sincere Campbell, a 17-year-old boy who was gunned down outside a deli a block away from his family's Bronx home in 2024, police said.

item.title: Jewels worth $120,000 swiped from car in Brooklyn, thieves sought
item.description: The NYPD released surveillance images of three men suspected of breaking into the car through the driver's side window on Ave. U and E. 26th St. in Sheepshead Bay around 7:47 p.m. on Jan. 14.

item.title: Asking Eric: Husband’s childhood friends pull him away from family
